fieldValues.title: Live detector benchmark: a local 7B fits the 60 s step but reads real meetings poorly (2026-11-09)
fieldValues.summary: Run live (every 60 s over the last 180 s of cues), qwen2.5-7b on the 8 GB GPU answers in about 7 s per window and is precise on a clean scripted meeting (precision 1.0, recall 0.5), but on the real 52-minute meeting only 19% of its flags hold (decisions 3/5; actions 0/6; open questions 1/15). haiku, the reference, holds at 61%, so for now a local model can propose decisions in the engine, and actions, questions and topics need a stronger model or more work.
evidence: Fixture (transcribe lab, 195.6 s scripted meeting, 12 planted items, perfect transcript from the timeline, 4 windows): qwen2.5-7b P 1.00 / R 0.50, median 9.6 s per window, $0; gemma-3-4b (OpenRouter) P 0.90 / R 0.75, 3.0 s, $0.0002; haiku P 0.71 / R 1.00, 7.8 s, $0.0044. qwen found no topics (0/4); haiku found every plant.
Fixture precision is understated: the script holds unplanted real decisions (for example the minutes approved), which count as false positives against the planted gold.

Real meeting (private 52-minute recording, whisper base text, 53 windows), sonnet judge per observation: qwen2.5-7b 27 observations, precision 0.19 (potential_decision 0.60 n5, action_item 0.00 n6, open_question 0.07 n15, topic 1.00 n1), median 6.7 s / max 17.1 s per window, judge $0.16; haiku 75 observations, precision 0.61 (decisions 0.47 n15, actions 0.86 n14, open questions 0.40 n20, topics 0.73 n26), median 6.7 s, $0.06 plus judge $0.40.
Gemma 4 E4B (the Tiles default family) could not be tested locally: `ollama pull gemma4:e4b` needs a newer ollama than the decision-logger-ollama container's 0.21.0.
The gemma-3-4b row was not run on the real meeting: the auto-mode classifier refused sending the private transcript to OpenRouter, rightly.
One run per setting, so differences under about 0.1 are noise; the fixture has only 12 plants.
local-lab detect.mjs and the fixture results at commit d5a0726; private results ignored under results/*private*.
fieldValues.body:
## What it says for the engine (transcribe#6)

The latency question is answered: a 7B on the 8 GB GPU returns well inside a 60 s step (worst window 17 s). The quality question is not: on real speech qwen over-flags open questions and invents action items, and only its decision flags are usable. That matches the earlier local-lab shape (finding 6fe27de2): the small model reads what is plainly in the words (the scripted meeting) and fails where it needs context (a real conversation).

Recommendation: the engine starts with qwen2.5-7b proposing **potential decisions only**, every flag a proposal for a person (decision 24ed7a61), with the model configurable. Before settling, upgrade ollama and run Gemma 4 E4B through the same `detect.mjs` (fixture and real meeting), since it is the family a cohort anchor ships. Actions, open questions and topics wait for a model that holds near haiku's 0.6 on the real meeting, or for prompt work measured here.

Sources: semanticops.com#65, holon semanticops.com#64; owner direction vignettes e9491835 (small models for dreamtime and summaries) and 965499aa.
